verdict.rationale: Injecting per-caller context is a fair axis for a voice-agent framework, but no evidence item documents passing dynamic variables or per-session data into a bot at call time. Starting Cloud sessions, receiving telephony webhooks, and Flows functions that call external APIs are adjacent features. None of them describes per-call personalization inputs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
